verdict.rationale: Docs show an API client (edison-client) that can submit tasks like literature review jobs and retrieve results, suggesting core agent capabilities are accessible via API, not just UI. However, there is no evidence of full parity — no OpenAPI spec found (404s), no confirmation that all UI features (e.g., token management, dataset uploads, all specialized agents like Molecules/Precedent) are exposed via API. Missing for 10: OpenAPI/API reference documenting full endpoint coverage, explicit statement of API-UI feature parity, evidence that account/token management and all specialized agents are API-accessible, independent confirmation of completeness.
